analysis.scope: Bounded source triage: explicit __le/__be destination, supported object write grammar, source-local object macros before the write and integer expressions safe under both ILP32/LP64. Conditional/header macros, unknown calls, ambiguous declarations, unproven narrowing and alias-slot authority refused. BIT/BIT_ULL built-in semantics are an explicit model assumption and cannot create new candidates. No first-consumer, full preprocessing, path feasibility or hardware execution proof. v5 retains original declaration/lvalue depth; pointer-object writes are separately filtered, array objects and unsupported compound/root layers remain insufficient. Indexing or explicit dereference consumes only a proven layer. Conditional member declarations are refused; canonical outer #ifndef/#define header guards are inventory assumptions only, not actual compilation/include-order proof. A scalar normal verdict remains local; no buffer consumer, bounds, pointer validity, or hardware proof is added.
